glosses: Qui être lu de manière automatisée.

examples.text: „Im Fall der Barcodes, die in Geschäften verwendet werden, verlangen Gesetze häufig, dass neben dem maschinenlesbaren Barcode und der Preisangabe an der Kasse ein menschenlesbarer Preis an der Ware angebracht wird.“

glosses: Capable of being read by a machine, especially a computer system.

examples.text: This encoded every single piece of information about you, your body and your life into one all-purpose machine-readable card that you could then carry around in your wallet, and therefore represented technology’s greatest triumph to date over both itself and plain common sense.

glosses: Organised or formatted in a way that permits unambiguous interpretation by a program.

examples.text: An ASCII text file may not be considered machine-readable if its contents do not follow a predictable, well-defined structure.
